component: FastAPI backend (backend/app.py, backend/engine.py) reusing scripts/smoke_inference.py, scripts/athn.py, scripts/eval_metrics.py unchanged
model_loading: once at startup (lifespan); checkpoint SHA-256 verified; weights_only load; failure -> 503 on inference endpoints
concurrency: bounded semaphore (CV_MAX_CONCURRENCY, default 1); wait up to CV_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_S then 503 busy; per-call timeout CV_INFERENCE_TIMEOUT_S (default 120 s) -> 504
default_mode: proposed (declared in artifacts/M7/FROZEN_CONFIG.json before M8); baseline selectable per request
security_controls: max side and max pixel limits checked from the header before decoding
MIME allow-list (png, jpeg) plus magic-byte check
no temp files; images processed in memory and not retained
logs: request id, path, status, latency only
structured errors with request id; no stack traces returned
Decimal amounts; strict grammars; no digit repair
known_limitation: proposed mode on enlarged written-amount lines can exceed the 120 s timeout (5 of 89 synthetic written test lines in M8)
